Random Forest Analysis (Revision)

Sarah Lotspeich

2026-08-21

Setup

# Load packages
library(missALI) ## for models x missing data corrections 
library(pROC) ## for ROC curves and AUC 
library(ggplot2) ## for plots (in general)
library(patchwork) ## for multi-panel plots 

# Read in data on hospitalizations (suppressed for privacy)
#hosp_dat = read.csv("~/Documents/missALI/data/deidentified_ali_hospitalizations.csv")
hosp_dat = read.csv("~/Documents/Allostatic_load_audits/revision_analysis_dat.csv") |> 
  ## Exclude one person with no vitals/labs before hospitalization day so all components missing
  filter(!is.na(ALI))

# Define vector of binary ALI component column names
ali_comp = c("A1C", "ALB", "BMI", "CHOL", "CRP",
              "CREAT_C", "HCST", "TRIG", "BP_DIASTOLIC", "BP_SYSTOLIC")

Exclusions

  • Patients whose first primary care encounters were not at least 90 days before the end of the study period.
  • For patients who were hospitalized, only visits and labs before their hospitalization (at least 1 day but no more than 3 years) were included in the averages used for ALI components.
  • One patient (who was hospitalized) only had vitals and labs on their day of hospitalization, so they were missing all 10 components and had to be excluded.
  • Altogether, these exclusions left us with \(n=\) 707 patients’ data.

Results

Summary Measure Models

Approach 1: Proportion of Non-Missing Components That Are Unhealthy

Fit to Full Sample

# Logistic regression + complete-case proportion
mod_rf_prop = cc_prop_approach(outcome = "ANY_ADMIT", 
                                covar = c("SEX", "AGE_AT_ENCOUNTER"), 
                                ali = ali_comp,
                                data = hosp_dat, 
                                family = "binomial", 
                                use_glm = FALSE) 

# Create plots and calculate metrics 
out = summ_plot_fit(
  mod = mod_rf_prop, 
  col = miss_meth_cols[1], 
  method_title = "Complete-Case\nProportion", 
  model_type = "Random Forest", 
  missing = "Complete-Case Proportion", 
  separate_components = "Summary Measure")

# Save plots as separate objects 
## ROC 
roc_rf_prop = out$roc
## Calibration plot  
cal_rf_prop = out$cal

# Save AUC to dataframe 
save_auc = out$df

# Save calibration table to separate csv 
out$cal_table |> 
  write.csv("~/Documents/missALI/analysis/detailed_calibration_results/random_forest/full_sample/complete_case_proportion.csv", row.names = FALSE)

5-Fold Cross-Validated

# Make fold assignment reproducible (same for all models + approaches)
set.seed(918)

# 5-fold cross validation of the logistic regression model with complete-case proportion ALI
kfold_rf_cc_prop = kfold_validate(outcome = "ANY_ADMIT", 
                                   covar = c("SEX", "AGE_AT_ENCOUNTER"), 
                                   ali = ali_comp,
                                   data = hosp_dat, 
                                   family = "binomial", 
                                   miss_method = "cc_prop", 
                                   folds = 5, 
                                   use_glm = FALSE)

# Create plots and calculate metrics 
out_kfold = summ_plot_fit_kfold_pooled(
  kfold_res = kfold_rf_cc_prop, 
  col = miss_meth_cols[1], 
  method_title = "Complete-Case\nProportion", 
  model_type = "Random Forest", 
  missing = "Complete-Case Proportion", 
  separate_components = "Summary Measure", 
  xlim = c(0, 0.7), 
  ylim = c(0, 0.7))

# Save plots as separate objects 
## ROC 
roc_rf_prop_k = out_kfold$roc
## Calibration plot  
cal_rf_prop_k = out_kfold$cal

# Save calibration table to separate csv 
out_kfold$cal_table |>
  write.csv("~/Documents/missALI/analysis/detailed_calibration_results/random_forest/cross_validated/complete_case_proportion.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save AUC to dataframe 
save_auc = save_auc |> 
  dplyr::bind_rows(out_kfold$df)

Approach 6: Pattern Submodels (Separate)

Fit to Full Sample

# Logistic regression + pattern submodels (separate components)
mod_rf_patsub = pattern_submod_approach(outcome = "ANY_ADMIT",
                                         covar = c("SEX", "AGE_AT_ENCOUNTER"),
                                         ali = ali_comp,
                                         data = hosp_dat,
                                         family = "binomial", 
                                         use_glm = FALSE)

# Count how many patients had missing data patterns that needed CCS or nesting
table(mod_rf_patsub$data$complete_case_submodel) ## complete-case submodel
## 
## FALSE  TRUE 
##   664    43
table(mod_rf_patsub$data$nested) ## nested 
## 
## FALSE  TRUE 
##   694    13
# Create plots and calculate metrics 
out = summ_plot_fit(
  mod = mod_rf_patsub, 
  col = miss_meth_cols[8], 
  method_title = "Pattern\nSubmodels", 
  model_type = "Random Forest", 
  missing = "Pattern Submodels", 
  separate_components = "Separate Components")

# Save plots as separate objects 
## ROC 
roc_rf_submod = out$roc
## Calibration plot  
cal_rf_submod = out$cal

# Save calibration table to separate csv 
out$cal_table |>
  write.csv("~/Documents/missALI/analysis/detailed_calibration_results/random_forest/full_sample/pattern_submodels.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save AUC to dataframe 
save_auc = save_auc |> 
  dplyr::bind_rows(out$df)

5-Fold Cross-Validated

# Make fold assignment reproducible (same for all models + approaches)
set.seed(918)

# 5-fold cross validation of the logistic regression model with best-case imputation
kfold_rf_submod_sep = kfold_validate(outcome = "ANY_ADMIT", 
                                      covar = c("SEX", "AGE_AT_ENCOUNTER"), 
                                      ali = ali_comp,
                                      data = hosp_dat, 
                                      family = "binomial", 
                                      miss_method = "patsub", 
                                      comp_sep = TRUE,
                                      folds = 5, 
                                      use_glm = FALSE)
# Count how many patients had missing data patterns that needed CCS or nesting
kfold_test_dat = lapply(
  kfold_rf_submod_sep$all_fold_res,
  function(x) x$test_data
) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()
table(kfold_test_dat$complete_case_submodel) ## complete-case submodel
## 
## FALSE  TRUE 
##   638    69
table(kfold_test_dat$nested) ## nested 
## 
## FALSE  TRUE 
##   694    13
# Create plots and calculate metrics 
out_kfold = summ_plot_fit_kfold_pooled(
  kfold_res = kfold_rf_submod_sep, 
  col = miss_meth_cols[8], 
  method_title = "Pattern\nSubmodels", 
  model_type = "Random Forest", 
  missing = "Pattern Submodels", 
  separate_components = "Separate Components", 
  xlim = c(0, 0.7), 
  ylim = c(0, 0.7))

# Save plots as separate objects 
## ROC 
roc_rf_submod_k = out_kfold$roc
## Calibration plot

# Save calibration table to separate csv

  write.csv("~/Documents/missALI/analysis/detailed_calibration_results/random_forest/cross_validated/pattern_submodels.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save AUC to dataframe 
save_auc = save_auc |> 
  dplyr::bind_rows(out_kfold$df)
